$comment: CodeSocks schema: English comments and descriptions. Example ships disabled by default to avoid exposing a placeholder proxy.
title: CodeSocks configuration
description: codesocks.jsonc file: accepts comments and trailing commas. Fail-closed on invalid syntax or unknown fields.

$schema.description: Schema path or URL (optional, documentation only).

enabled.description: When false, the plugin stays disabled and uses no proxy.

proxies.description: Name -> proxy URL map. Secrets via {env:NAME}; never log the URL.

additionalProperties.description: http, https, socks4, socks4a, socks5, socks5h schemes; no path, query, or fragment.

proxy.description: Name of a proxy declared in proxies.

allowedOrigins.description: Exact allowed http(s) origins (required, no path).

minIntervalMs.description: Minimum interval between requests in ms (default 0).
